def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    utility_threshold = case['utility_threshold']
    # Build dicts
    nodes_dict = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n['id']: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        parent = n.get('parent')
        if parent:
            children[parent].append(n['id'])
    # Initial queue
    queue = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    queue_ids = [n['id'] for n in queue]
    removed = set()
    visit_order = []
    # Process queue
    while queue_ids:
        node_id = queue_ids.pop(0)
        if node_id in removed:
            continue
        visit_order.append(node_id)
        node = nodes_dict[node_id]
        child_ids = children.get(node_id, [])
        is_leaf = all(c in removed for c in child_ids)
        if node['removable'] and is_leaf and node['utility'] <= utility_threshold:
            removed.add(node_id)
            parent_id = node['parent']
            if parent_id is not None and parent_id not in removed:
                queue_ids.append(parent_id)
    # retained nodes in original order
    retained = [n['id'] for n in nodes if n['id'] not in removed]
    return {
        "retained_node_ids": retained,
        "visit_order": visit_order
    }
